Name: Baechu's Portraits (Content Patcher)
Author: orientalmelon
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]

Baechu's Portraits mod adapted for use with Content Patcher. The original artwork is taken from [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3218/]Baechu's Portraits Mod (XNB)[/url][/b]. [b]I am not the original artist.[/b]

Please see the [url=https://github.com/koreanmelon/baechus-portraits-cp]GitHub repository[/url] for more details on what portraits are included in this mod.

[b]Alternate Assets[/b]
To use the alternate assets, edit the config.json file. If you have the mod Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can change between assets there.

[b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]

If you have SVE installed, please download the SVE version of the mod. That zip file contains portraits for both base game characters [i]and[/i] SVE characters, so there is no need to download both.

[b][size=5]FAQ[/size][/b]

[b]How do I submit an bug/issue[/b]?

Please submit bug reports using GitHub Issues. It's quite hard to get notifications through Nexus Mods.
